checks.name: recovery_evidence
checks.reason: Recovery comparison requires matching graded policies and actual fault exercise on both sides. Normal runs are not recovery tests.

checks.name: security_evidence
checks.reason: Both security grades must be available with the same evaluator version.

checks.name: grounding_evidence
checks.reason: Both grounding grades must be available with the same evaluator version.

checks.name: request_measurements
checks.reason: Both sides need recorded model requests; scripted or historical runs have no model timing/usage.

checks.name: complete_usage
checks.reason: Token deltas require complete core usage on both sides, not partial subtotals.

checks.name: same_model_identity
checks.reason: Token deltas require the same provider and one matching reported model; Ollama also requires matching nonempty weight digests.

notes: This is one recorded observation per side, not a reliability rate or proof of general improvement.
Tool-policy grades audit attempted sandbox actions, not general security. Grounding grades check only the typed refund report against agent-visible tool responses, not arbitrary prose.
Request time is client-observed across all attempts. Loading, caching, hardware, request count, and failures can differ; no speedup claim is inferred.
Token values are known subtotals when usage is incomplete. Suppressed deltas are unavailable, not zero. No dollar cost or semantic answer score is calculated.
